rows.title: Married My Ex's Dad, Now I'm Mafia Queen
rows.sourceSynopsis: Isabella is dumped at the altar by her fiancé Alex. To save her dignity and get revenge, she marries his father, Damien, the most powerful mafia boss. After the marriage, with her sharp wit and growing influence, she tears down her ex, reclaims her mother's stolen fortune, crushes family betrayals, and rises from an abandoned bride to a mafia queen. Along the way, a cold contract marriage with Damien turns into something real, a fierce, unstoppable love.

rows.title: Left at the Altar, Married Power
rows.sourceSynopsis: Linsey was overjoyed to marry her fiancé Felix, until he was called away by a single phone call from that homewrecker. Humiliated at her own wedding, Linsey hit rock bottom. Then the homewrecker called again, just to gloat. But Linsey didn't cry. She turned around, walked outside the church, and married the first man she saw. As fate would have it, he turned out to be the most powerful man in the city...

rows.title: Mated To My Boyfriend's Brother
rows.sourceSynopsis: Sophia, an Omega, finds out her boy friend Bruce cheated with her bestie Louisa, before her eighteenth birthday. But soon, she finds out Bruce's brother Bryan, the Alpha, is her destined mate. It is on Bryan's engagement banquet, and her words ruin it. Bryan is furious and sacks her brother, which causes her mother to get sick. To save her family, Sophia becomes his personal secretary. He is cold to her, yet his wolf longs for her. After conflicts and crises, they forge real feelings and form a real mate bond.

rows.title: The King's Physician Bride
rows.sourceSynopsis: Hilwyn, a noble healer who despises aristocratic constraints, treats King Lucien for a chronic poisoning that has been mistaken for impotence. To protect his secret and avoid marriage pressure, Lucien proposes a contractual marriage, eighty thousand gold coins, no interference, and separate lives. But their constant bickering masks an unexpected bond. As Hilwyn risks everything to detoxify him and proves her skill before the royal court, Lucien moves from cold indifference to possessive devotion. When he tears up their contract and confesses his heart, Hilwyn must choose between her hard-won independence and a love she never anticipated...

rows.title: The Trophy Wife's War
rows.sourceSynopsis: With Julian as her shield, Seraphina fights back using hidden reserves, intelligence contacts, and tactical brilliance. But her ultimate goal is not just victory—it is finding her little sister, "Nine," sold to traffickers years ago. The hunt has just begun.

rows.title: His Neglected Wife Is The Top Scientist
rows.sourceSynopsis: June, a genius scientist, gave up her career to marry Cole. She did this for love, yet Cole neglected her. When she was bleeding out from miscarriage, he was with his mistress Alycia. June lost her child, her ability to conceive, and her love for him. She started research again, tackled Cole's slander, and took back her stolen works. She was still the top scientist.

rows.title: Reborn, I Choose The Other Groom
rows.sourceSynopsis: In her past life, Cathy made her adopted brother Rory marry her. Her stepsister Marlee, in love with Rory, killed herself. Rory was furious and accidentally killed Cathy. Reborn before the wedding, Cathy chooses to let Marlee have Rory, and takes on the family duty of marrying Nate, the crippled son of the Moss family. After marriage, Cathy finds that Nate's disability is actually caused by his uncle Theo and stepmother Martha. The couple take back family power and punish the villains, forming a true family with love and children, leaving Rory in regret.

rows.title: Designing My New Life
rows.sourceSynopsis: Thea and Chase had been married for three years, but misunderstandings and interference from Lily tore the couple apart. After enduring countless grievances, Thea resolutely filed for divorce, dedicated herself to her talent in fashion design, and rebuilt her career in the fashion world, reclaiming her dreams and achieving success. Chase, after facing life-threatening dangers, finally recognized his true feelings and went all out to make amends. Through hardships, they resolved every misunderstanding, broke down all barriers, and reunited through mutual understanding and redemption, ultimately finding complete happiness together.

rows.title: Marrying The Merman King
rows.sourceSynopsis: Vivian is a simple woman who wants a test-tube baby, yet she accidentally carries the baby of William, king of the merfolk. Betrayed by her family and fiancé, she has no choice but to marry Willaim and go live with him in the Deep Sea Palace. The merfolk reject a human queen, and many noble ladies covet William. Vivian works hard to establish herself among the hostilities, and true feelings emerge between the couple.

rows.title: Secret Triplets: Second Chance With My Billionaire
rows.sourceSynopsis: On the day of her mother's funeral, Cailin Morton witnesses her fiancé Hilliard Holloway returning home with his mistress Charla. Heartbroken, she fakes a miscarriage and leaves him, raising her three genius children with him alone. After their reunion, the children team up to prank their father. Hilliard gradually discovers the children are his. Charla tries to frame her, but the couple eventually resolves all misunderstandings. The man wins back his wife and children, and the family lives happily ever after.

rows.title: Weak Yesterday, Unstoppable Today
rows.sourceSynopsis: Zen, heir of the House Blackwood, was betrayed and sold into slavery by his own family, until he awakened the Prometheus Fire, a power that turned his wounds into strength. He escaped and joined the temple trials to find his sister Yana, who was exiled to the frozen wastes. Against rival nobles like Perrin and shadowy conspiracies, Zen survived deadly trials, earned the favor of Frost Tower's master Aura, and uncovered an ancient tome in the Stardust Corridor. As he grew stronger, he peeled back the lies behind his family's fall and his sister's banishment. Every scar made him sharper, every enemy brought him closer to the truth, and to the throne that was stolen from him.

research_json.lane: 黑帮大佬 / 前任父亲 / 契约婚姻 / 弃婚反击
research_json.genre: 现代都市 / 黑帮爱情
research_json.payoff: 当场反转婚礼羞辱；前任被持续打脸；追回母亲财产；女主获得权力与身份跃迁；契约婚姻转为真爱。
research_json.conflict: Alex的背叛、家族对母亲财产的侵占，以及Isabella进入黑帮权力中心后的家族对抗，共同推动她从弃妇到掌权者。
research_json.mismatch: 核心关系是“嫁给前任父亲”，存在明显年龄差与家庭伦理争议；适合作为高概念钩子，但投流需避免将权力差包装成强迫关系。
research_json.synopsis: Isabella is dumped at the altar by fiancé Alex and, to reclaim her dignity and retaliate, marries Alex's father Damien, a powerful mafia boss. She then fights her ex and family betrayals, seeks to recover her mother's stolen fortune, gains influence and develops a real relationship with Damien.
research_json.storyCore: 婚礼受辱的女主转身嫁给前任父亲这一更高权力男性，在婚姻联盟中完成复仇、夺回家产并获得新的爱情与地位。
research_json.storySkin: Mafia boss + ex's father + contract marriage + abandoned bride + family fortune
research_json.safetyConflictNote: 关系涉及明显年龄差和黑帮权力差；官方简介可确认契约婚姻与后续恋爱，但未见强迫性关系证据。
research_json.localizationJudgment: Mafia、age-gap、contract marriage与英语姓名均属于欧美短剧成熟商业包装，题材识别直接。

research_json.payoff: 背叛关系被替换为更高位命定伴侣；Alpha狼性吸引持续释放；冲突关系转为真实mate bond。
research_json.conflict: 背叛、命定伴侣与既有婚约冲突叠加；Bryan因订婚宴受损而迁怒Sophia，并通过解雇其兄长间接加重她的家庭压力。
research_json.mismatch: 官方简介明确背叛发生在Sophia十八岁生日之前，但没有明确说明她与Bryan的恋爱/伴侣关系从何时开始；年龄时间线存在必须单独核验的合规风险。
research_json.synopsis: Omega Sophia discovers boyfriend Bruce cheated with her best friend Louisa shortly before her eighteenth birthday. She then learns Bruce's Alpha brother Bryan is her destined mate. After disrupting Bryan's engagement and triggering a family crisis, Sophia becomes Bryan's secretary; conflict and attraction eventually lead them toward a mate bond.
research_json.storyCore: 遭男友与闺蜜背叛的低位Omega发现真正命定伴侣是前任的Alpha哥哥，并在强冲突和被迫近距离相处中转向新的伴侣关系。
research_json.storySkin: Werewolf + Alpha/Omega + fated mate + engagement banquet + personal secretary
research_json.safetyConflictNote: 未成年时间线存在实质风险：公开简介只确认“before her eighteenth birthday”，不能据此推断后续mate关系已满18岁。内容与投流应在年龄未核清前谨慎处理。
research_json.localizationJudgment: Alpha/Omega、fated mate、mate bond等英语狼人言情语汇高度成熟，类型识别直接。
